metadata.rule_name: AWS WAF - Allowed request to unauthorized API

event.query:
SELECT
  url_path,
  outcome,
  waf_web_acl_id
FROM waf
WHERE outcome <> 'blocked'
  AND waf_web_acl_id != 'arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:111111111111:regional/webacl/ClienteXYZProdWAF/6b09c5a1-02f1-4fcf-b01c-70bf1eed8ab7'
  AND NOT regexp_like(
    url_path,
      '^/((api|admin)/)?(enrollment-autenticacion-screen|dual-onboarding|demo-screen)(/.*|$)'
   || '|^/((api|admin)/)?(dashboard|blacklist|config|error|validation-in-progress|invalid-session)(/.*|$)'
   || '|^/((api|admin)/)?(users?|profile-photos|perfil|reports|selfie-auth)(/.*|$)'
   || '|^/((api|admin)/)?(funnel-end(-auth)?|entra-id)(/.*|$)'
   || '|^/((api|admin)/)?(sdk|sanctum|service|liveness|audit)(/.*|$)'
   || '|^/((api|admin)/)?((a|e)/[^/]+|[^/]+/(auth|webhook)|$)'
   || '|^/((api|admin)/)?(authenti(fi)?cations?|enrollment|self-enrollment)(/.*|$)'
   || '|^/((api|admin)/)?(leads?|bureaus-[^/]+|[^/]+-section)(/.*|$)'
   || '|^/((api|admin)/)?(livewire|vapor(-ui)?|flux|build|assets|\\.well-known|[^/]+\\.(ico|txt|png|xml|json|webmanifest))(/.*|$)'
   || '|^/((api|admin)/)?(admin|api|login|logout|refresh|two-factor-challenge|test)(/.*|$)'
  )
  AND url_path NOT IN (
    '/robots.txt',
    '/favicon.ico'
  );

security_detection.description: alertará cuando el WAF permita una request a un path que se encuentre por fuera del listado de paths permitidos para acceso desde internet
security_detection.resolution: De momento: Informar para tratamiento con ClienteXYZ
